Title: Clan Impersonations and Praxis Seizure Question

Messages.Author: Khaleph Alendis
Messages.Body:
I have a toreador vampire that have the Writ of Acceptance with him.

I play on him Praxis Seizure: Monaco and the vote is successful. So,
his capacity increases by 1.

Some turn after that, i play Clan Impersonations on the same vampire to
change him in a Setite. The capacity of the vampire stay or not the
same ? (With the +1 of the Praxis)

Thank's,

Card Text:

"If the Prince is Toreador his or her capacity increases by one."

You will not keep the bonus if you do not stay Toreador. While the
vampire will keep the title because of the Writ of Acceptance, it will
lose the bonus capacity because it is not a Toreador.

Carpe noctem.

Vampires/Crypt/Uncontrolled Region
* If a vampire changes Clans and/or Sects, it retains all other
Characteristics it had before the switch. EXCEPTIONS: Sect
(Camarilla/Non-Camarilla) is changed to the new Clan's sect. Clan-based
capacity (e.g., from a Seized Praxis) is removed (or added) based on
the new clan. [RTR 08-JUL-1996]
